sentences.text: Adrian and Stella have been testing some wearable fitness trackers.
They are now reviewing them for the podcast.
Listen to their conversation and complete the information in the spaces below.
The first one has been provided as an example.
You now have 30 seconds to study the task.
At the end of the task, you will have one minute to tidy up your answers.
